def snapshot(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']); c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((r0,c0,r1,c1,n['pixels']))
    return d
before = snapshot(current_frame)
res = action(['RIGHT'])
after = snapshot(current_frame)
for k in set(before)|set(after):
    if before.get(k)!=after.get(k):
        print("CHANGED", k, before.get(k), "->", after.get(k))
print("result", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','done','game_over')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
